recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current source change is needed, and adding redundant prose or re-editing the search parameter bundles would not improve implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-25048 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked that search parameters over choice elements, specifically Procedure-date on Procedure.occurrence[x], avoid exposing irrelevant datatypes and said similar search parameters should be reviewed.
initial_application: The issue was applied in d1f2f1ca6e, which changed Procedure-date and parallel checked-in search parameter bundles from raw choice paths to typed expressions. A later commit, 7b140eccee, changed Procedure-date from as() to ofType() after FHIRPath behavior was clarified.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini and source/procedure/bundle-Procedure-search-params.xml is in the current build-scope source. Historical files for ChargeItem and MedicationUsage are no longer active core resource directories; MedicationStatement carries the corresponding filtered effective[x] expression. FHIR-20627, already represented on the combined branch, supports the current Procedure.occurrence[x] datatype set including Timing.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Procedure-date currently has path Procedure.occurrence[x], type date, and expression Procedure.occurrence.ofType(dateTime) | Procedure.occurrence.ofType(Period) | Procedure.occurrence.ofType(Timing). A strict current-source scan found no remaining unfiltered non-template choice search parameter blocks matching the FHIR-25048 pattern.

related_jiras.note: Procedure.occurrence[x] Timing support is already audited on the combined branch and explains why the current Procedure-date filter includes Timing.
